# Spot

```{image} ../../imgs/bd_spot.jpg
:alt: The Spot environment
:width: 60%
:align: center
```

Spot is the quadruped robot by Boston Dynamics. The model is based on the Spot description by Clearpath Robotics and the model in MuJoCo Menagerie.

## Quick start

The registered name of this environment is `BDSpot`. There is no motion capture data for it, so it is created with {class}`~loco_mujoco.task_factories.rl_factory.RLFactory`, whose default task is to track a commanded root velocity.

`````{tab-set}
````{tab-item} MuJoCo (CPU)
```python
from loco_mujoco.task_factories import RLFactory

env, _ = RLFactory.make("BDSpot")

import numpy as np

env.reset()
for _ in range(1000):
    action = np.random.uniform(-1.0, 1.0, env.info.action_space.shape)
    obs, reward, absorbing, done, info = env.step(action)
    env.render()
```
````
````{tab-item} MJX (GPU)
```python
import jax

from loco_mujoco.task_factories import RLFactory

env, _ = RLFactory.make("MjxBDSpot")

n_envs = 1024
reset = jax.jit(jax.vmap(env.mjx_reset, in_axes=(0, None)))
step = jax.jit(jax.vmap(env.mjx_step, in_axes=(0, 0, None)))

keys = jax.random.split(jax.random.key(0), n_envs)
state = reset(keys, None)
action = jax.vmap(env.sample_action_space)(keys)
state = step(state, action, None)
```
````
`````

## Constructor options

This embodiment has no arguments of its own.

All environments also accept `spec`, `observation_spec` and `actuation_spec` to replace the model, the observation space and the set of actuators, and the arguments of {class}`~loco_mujoco.environments.base.LocoEnv` and {class}`~loco_mujoco.core.mujoco_base.Mujoco`, such as `timestep`, `n_substeps`, `reward_type`, `control_type` or `terrain_type`. See the [modular architecture](../user_guide/modular_architecture.md).

## Observation space

The default observation has 35 dimensions: the pose of the floating base without its horizontal position, the joint positions, the velocity of the floating base and the joint velocities. A task factory may append further entries; {class}`~loco_mujoco.task_factories.rl_factory.RLFactory`, for example, adds the velocity goal. See [observations](../user_guide/observations.md) for how to change the observation space.

| Index | Name | Observation type | Dim | Model element |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Action space

The action has 12 dimensions, one per actuator, each in [-1, 1]. The default control type of this environment is {class}`~loco_mujoco.core.control_functions.pd.PDControl`: an action is a joint position target, given as an offset from the nominal joint positions. The action is used as it is, in the unit of the joint, and is not scaled to the joint range. The target is clipped to the joint range, and the torque of the PD controller is clipped to the control range of the actuator. Another [control function](../user_guide/control_functions.md) can be selected with `control_type`.

| Index | Actuator | Acts on | Type | Joint range | Control range |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `fl_hx` | `fl_hx` | torque | [-0.7854, 0.7854] | [-100, 100] |
| 1 | `fl_hy` | `fl_hy` | torque | [-0.8988, 2.295] | [-100, 100] |
| 2 | `fl_kn` | `fl_kn` | torque | [-2.793, -0.2544] | [-100, 100] |
| 3 | `fr_hx` | `fr_hx` | torque | [-0.7854, 0.7854] | [-100, 100] |
| 4 | `fr_hy` | `fr_hy` | torque | [-0.8988, 2.244] | [-100, 100] |
| 5 | `fr_kn` | `fr_kn` | torque | [-2.793, -0.2556] | [-100, 100] |
| 6 | `hl_hx` | `hl_hx` | torque | [-0.7854, 0.7854] | [-100, 100] |
| 7 | `hl_hy` | `hl_hy` | torque | [-0.8988, 2.295] | [-100, 100] |
| 8 | `hl_kn` | `hl_kn` | torque | [-2.793, -0.2471] | [-100, 100] |
| 9 | `hr_hx` | `hr_hx` | torque | [-0.7854, 0.7854] | [-100, 100] |
| 10 | `hr_hy` | `hr_hy` | torque | [-0.8988, 2.295] | [-100, 100] |
| 11 | `hr_kn` | `hr_kn` | torque | [-2.793, -0.2483] | [-100, 100] |
